result.summary: Found 1 issue: a delivery fee displays an invalid "NaN" value instead of a price.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" section, the delivery fee under "Smash Bros Burgers" reads "€NaN delivery" instead of a valid amount.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee calculation or data source so a numeric price is shown, and fall back to a placeholder or hide the fee when the value is missing.
